messages:
Nora: Kicking off SeaGlass joint bench. Aim: end-to-end perf/W, p95/p99, and robustness across kernel IO scheduler variants. Need test matrix, telemetry schema, and PR/announce plan. @Dan can SeaGlass expose per-board power telemetry and kernel builds?
Dan (SeaGlass): Yes — we can stream board_power_w via sg-agent and export two kernel builds: sg-io-v1 and sg-io-v2 (affinity + async IO). We'll also provide a small sysctl patch list. ETA artifacts: 48h.
Eric: Proposed matrix: (1) stock kernel, (2) sg-io-v1, (3) sg-io-v2 + thermal cap mode. Runs: 3 repeats each. Metrics: tokens/sec, J/token, p95/p99 latency, and tail OOM/rcu stalls.
Nora: Hardware: 4 x seaglass-c2 racks (8 GPUs each) + 2 edge nodes. Eric will provision and drop results at s3://redwood-seaglass/2076543210/results/.
BenchBot: Schedule registered: kickoff=2076543210 dry-run=2076543600 full-sweep=2076543800-2076545400. Notifications -> #bench-ops.
Eric: Workloads: long-fill (seq=2048, batch=3), burst (seq=64, batch=64), and synthetic single-token hotloop for kernel overhead. Collect gpu_power_w, board_power_w, host_temp_c, and kernel_label.
Dan (SeaGlass): We can also attach per-process I/O latency histograms and provide a power clamp accessory for constrained mode.
Nora: Telemetry format: JSONL lines: [iso_ts, host, run_id, gpu_power_w, board_power_w, tokens, latency_ms_p50_p95_p99, kernel_label]. Save raw traces + a summary CSV per run.
Eric: Example dry-run command:
```
./bench_tool --model rwd-3b --seq 2048 --batch 3 --profile energy --out s3://redwood-seaglass/2076543210/results/dry1.json --run-id dry-1
```
Eric: I'll push harness to github.com/redwood-inference/bench/sea-glass-io branch sg-sweeps.
Dan (SeaGlass): We'll upload kernel tarballs and sysctl lists to s3://redwood-seaglass/2076543210/artifacts/ when ready.
Nora: Owners: Eric -> infra & runs; Dan -> kernel artifacts & telemetry; Nora -> partner comms + announcement draft; BenchBot -> schedule. Check-in tomorrow 9:30 PT.
Eric: Acceptance criteria suggestion: >=10% lower J/token on long-fill and no >1.4x p99 regression on burst. If criteria met across 3 runs we'll greenlight joint blog & reproducibility notebook.
Dan (SeaGlass): Agreed. Also request an embargo window of 72h for partner review before public posts.
Nora: Great. Action items recorded. If dry-run looks flaky we'll iterate on sysctl set and retest. Thanks :rocket:
